name: Parliament House, Dublin
scope: The former Parliament House at College Green in May 2024, including the surviving south Ionic colonnade, curved wings, eastern and western porticoes, banking wings and two internal courts.

references.filename: Benjamin Winkles - Bank of Ireland, Dublin (South Portico), page 22 (Volume One) - B1974.12.832 - Yale Center for British Art.jpg
references.dateBasis: Period of engraver’s recorded activity. Exact publication date is uncertain.

originalReview.notes: The nineteenth-century engraving shows the surviving open south portico, central pediment, flanking arches and curved Ionic colonnade.
Ridiculopathy’s May 2024 photograph shows the open tetrastyle Foster Place portico, limestone façade, pediment and rusticated lower openings.

review.method: Exact CC0 Qualla photograph and institutional historical engraving
review.notes: The exact Qualla May 2024 photograph matches Ridiculopathy’s first-party CC0 file. The Winkles south-portico engraving matches the Yale Center for British Art’s CC0 image. The historic drawing and early elevation depict proposals or earlier features that do not control the surviving exterior.
